title: Professional Certificate Course in Planning and Operating a Business
description: The aim of a course is to equip students with the knowledge and skills needed to start, operate and grow a successful business.
longDescription: Learn how to run a business. Understand the Requirements of a financial plan. Learn what the marketing plan is. Understand the business plan and its contents. The aim of a course on Planning and Operating a Business is to equip students with the knowledge and skills needed to start, operate and grow a successful business. By the end of the course, students should have a clear understanding of the various elements involved in the planning and execution of a business venture, including market research, financial projections, legal and regulatory requirements, funding options, and operational strategies.
